arxiv-2007-13648.title: Orpheus: A New Deep Learning Framework for Easy Deployment and Evaluation of Edge Inference
arxiv-2007-13648.creator: Perry Gibson, José Cano
arxiv-2007-13648.description: Abstract Optimising deep learning inference across edge devices and optimisation targets such as inference time, memory footprint and power consumption is a key challenge due to the ubiquity of neural networks. Today, production deep learning frameworks provide useful abstractions to aid machine learning engineers and systems researchers.

arxiv-2011-09541.title: Regularity of a gradient flow generated by the anisotropic Landau-de Gennes energy with a singular potential
arxiv-2011-09541.creator: Yuning Liu, Xin Yang Lu, Xiang Xu
arxiv-2011-09541.description: A 2020 arXiv research paper by Yuning Liu, Xin Yang Lu, Xiang Xu. In this paper we study a gradient flow generated by the Landau-de Gennes free energy that describes nematic liquid crystal configurations in the space of Q Q -tensors. This free energy density functional is composed of three quadratic terms as the elastic energy density part, and a singular potential in the bulk part that is considered as a natural enforcement of a physical constraint on the eigenvalues of Q Q .

arxiv-2107-05066.title: Initial Perturbation of the Mean Curvature Flow for Asymptotical Conical Limit Shrinker
arxiv-2107-05066.creator: Ao Sun, Jinxin Xue
arxiv-2107-05066.description: Abstract . This is the second paper in the series to study the initial perturbation of mean curvature flow. We study the initial perturbation of mean curvature flow, whose first singularity is modeled by an asymptotic conical shrinker. The noncompactness of the limiting shrinker creates essential difficulties.

arxiv-2107-12325.title: From Implicit to Explicit feedback: A deep neural network for modeling sequential behaviours and long-short term preferences of online users
arxiv-2107-12325.creator: Quyen Tran, Lam Tran, Linh Chu Hai, Linh Ngo Van, Khoat Than
arxiv-2107-12325.description: Abstract In this work, we examine the advantages of using multiple types of behaviour in recommendation systems. Intuitively, each user has to do some implicit actions (e.g., click) before making an explicit decision (e.g., purchase). Previous studies showed that implicit and explicit feedback have different roles for a useful recommendation.

arxiv-2211-10776.title: Bayesian modal regression based on mixture distributions
arxiv-2211-10776.creator: Qingyang Liu, Xianzheng Huang, Ray Bai
arxiv-2211-10776.description: Abstract Compared to mean regression and quantile regression, the literature on modal regression is very sparse. A unifying framework for Bayesian modal regression is proposed, based on a family of unimodal distributions indexed by the mode, along with other parameters that allow for flexible shapes and tail behaviors.

arxiv-2307-04742.title: Parallel Tempered Metadynamics: Overcoming potential barriers without surfing or tunneling
arxiv-2307-04742.creator: Timo Eichhorn, Gianluca Fuwa, Christian Hoelbling, Lukas Varnhorst
arxiv-2307-04742.description: Abstract At fine lattice spacings, Markov chain Monte Carlo simulations of QCD and other gauge theories with or without fermions are plagued by slow modes that give rise to large autocorrelation times. This can lead to simulation runs that are effectively stuck in one topological sector, a problem known as topological freezing.

arxiv-2309-06131.title: Annotating Data for Fine-Tuning a Neural Ranker? Current Active Learning Strategies are not Better than Random Selection Conference: Proceedings of the 1st International ACM SIGIR Conference on Information Retrieval in the Asia Pacific; November 26–29, 2023; Beijing, China Proceedings of the 1st Int
arxiv-2309-06131.creator: Sophia Althammer, Guido Zuccon, Sebastian Hofstätter, Suzan Verberne, Allan Hanbury
arxiv-2309-06131.description: Abstract . Search methods based on Pretrained Language Models (PLM) have demonstrated great effectiveness gains compared to statistical and early neural ranking models. However, fine-tuning PLM-based rankers requires a great amount of annotated training data. Annotating data involves a large manual effort and thus is expensive, especially in domain specific tasks.

Three of the pointings utilized only the three reddest bands (F1000W, F1500W, F2100W) while the remainder of the pointings also add a blue filter (F770W).

arxiv-2511-09265.title: Transversal Toffoli-gate in Hybrid-code System
arxiv-2511-09265.creator: Dawei Jiao 1 , Mahdi Bayanifar 1 , Alexei Ashikhmin 2 , Olav Tirkkonen 1
arxiv-2511-09265.description: Abstract We study the transversality of the Toffoli gate in a hybrid-code system that employs two quantum error correction codes with special structure. We find that a system using a triorthogonal code with its paired code supports a fully transversal implementation of the Toffoli gate. Through circuit-level analysis, we prove the transversality of the Toffoli operation in this system.

arxiv-2511-14854.title: The Penrose Transform and the Kerr-Schild double copy
arxiv-2511-14854.creator: Emma Albertini, Michael L. Graesser, Gabriel Herczeg
arxiv-2511-14854.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Emma Albertini, Michael L. Graesser, Gabriel Herczeg. There are a number of classical double copies, each providing a prescription for generating solutions to the Maxwell and scalar wave equations from exact solutions of Einstein’s equations. Two such prescriptions are the Kerr-Schild and twistorial double copies. We argue that for a broad class of self-dual vacuum solutions of the Kerr-Schild form, which we refer to as twistorial Kerr-Schild spacetimes , these two prescriptions are in fact equivalent.

pmc-10673539.title: Prophylactic Coloprotective Effect of Urtica dioica Leaves against Dextran Sulfate Sodium (DSS)-Induced Ulcerative Colitis in Rats
pmc-10673539.creator: Nouha Dakhli, Kais Rtibi, Fatma Arrari, Ala Ayari, Hichem Sebai, Renata Talar-Wojnarowska
pmc-10673539.description: Background and Objectives: Urtica dioica, a source of bioactive functional compounds, provides nutritional and gastrointestinal therapeutic benefits. This study attempted to investigate the prophylactic coloprotective action of an aqueous extract of Urtica dioica (AEUD) on dextran sulfate sodium (DSS)-induced ulcerative colitis (UC). Materials and Methods: Phenolic compounds, total sugar, and mineral levels were determined in AEUD.

pmc-11509196.title: Endoscopic Ultrasound and Gastric Sub-Epithelial Lesions: Ultrasonographic Features, Tissue Acquisition Strategies, and Therapeutic Management
pmc-11509196.creator: Marzia Varanese, Marco Spadaccini, Antonio Facciorusso, Gianluca Franchellucci, Matteo Colombo, Marta Andreozzi, Daryl Ramai, Davide Massimi, Roberto De Sire, Ludovico Alfarone, Antonio Capogreco, Roberta Maselli, Cesare Hassan, Alessandro Fugazza, Alessandro Repici, Silvia Carrara
pmc-11509196.description: Background and objectives: Subepithelial lesions (SELs) of the gastrointestinal (GI) tract present a diagnostic challenge due to their heterogeneous nature and varied clinical manifestations. Usually, SELs are small and asymptomatic; generally discovered during routine endoscopy or radiological examinations. Currently, endoscopic ultrasound (EUS) is the best tool to characterize gastric SELs.

pmc-11654199.title: Management and toxicological analysis of ocular hypertension after EyeCee® ONE intraocular lens implantation: a case series
pmc-11654199.creator: Paul Bastelica, Romain Magny, Joël Poupon, Bertrand Sonigo, Tristan Aubert, Françoise Brignole-Baudouin, Juliette Buffault, Christophe Baudouin, Antoine Labbé
pmc-11654199.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). BackgroundThe EyeCee® ONE intraocular lens (Nidek, Gamagori, Japan) has been withdrawn from the market due to a high number of reports of severe ocular hypertension (OHT) following phacoemulsification with implantation of this intraocular lens (IOL).

pmc-11731306.title: Acute Ventricular Dysfunction After Doxorubicin-Based Induction Therapy for Pediatric Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia
pmc-11731306.creator: Rajkumar Kundavaram, Amber Kumar, Sushma Konnepati, Yogendra S Yadav, Narendra K Chaudhary, Shikha Malik, Priya Gogia
pmc-11731306.description: BackgroundDoxorubicin is an important drug used in the treatment of children with acute leukemia, and cardiotoxicity is the most serious complication due to its use. The cardiac dysfunction due to doxorubicin can be acute, early, or late. Echocardiography is a non-invasive tool and can be employed to detect clinical and subclinical cardiac dysfunction and plan treatment strategies accordingly.

pmc-12431476.title: Radar Target Detection Based on Linear Fusion of Two Features
pmc-12431476.creator: Yong Huang, Yunhao Luan, Yunlong Dong, Hao Ding
pmc-12431476.description: Highlights What are the main findings? A linear dimensionality reduction method based on distribution compactness (using the ratio of kurtosis to interquartile range as the optimization criterion) is proposed to fuse phase linearity and relative peak height into a one-dimensional feature, enhancing the distinguishability between target and clutter data.

pmc-12457869.title: Ecological Momentary Assessment as a Measure of Intervention Change: Evaluation in 4 Digital Mental Health Trials
pmc-12457869.creator: Christian A Webb, Lori M Hilt, Caroline M Swords, Daniel M Bolt, Hadar Fisher, Simon B Goldberg, Taiane de Azevedo Cardoso, Christian A L Bean, Nur Hani Zainal, Madelyn R Frumkin
pmc-12457869.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundEcological momentary assessment (EMA) is increasingly being incorporated into intervention studies to acquire a more fine-grained and ecologically valid assessment of change. The added utility of including relatively burdensome EMA measures in a clinical trial hinges on several psychometric assumptions, including that these measure are (1) reliable, (2) related to but not redundant with conventional self-report measures (convergent and discriminant validity), (3) sensitive to intervention-related change, and (4) associated with a clinically relevant criterion of improvement (criterion validity) above conventional self-report measures

pmc-12636888.title: Co-transcriptional modifications of 2′-hydroxyls on synthetic mRNA enhance ribonuclease resistance and lipid nanoparticle thermostability
pmc-12636888.creator: Kohki Yamada, Yun-Chieh Sung, Tsung-Ying Lee, Daniel J. Siegwart
pmc-12636888.description: The innate fragility of messenger RNA (mRNA) stems from 2′-hydroxyls on the ribose that are responsible for making mRNA sensitive to enzymatic and thermal degradation, posing formidable challenges in efficacy, in vivo stability, global-scale distribution, and long-term storage of mRNA nanomedicines.

pmc-12704433.title: A miRNA cocktail orchestrates coordinated cellular responses to promote diabetic wound healing
pmc-12704433.creator: Yejing Huang, Liping Zhu, Jiating Wang, Ling Pan, Yong Yang, Dongqing Li
pmc-12704433.description: BackgroundChronic wounds, particularly diabetic ulcers, impose significant health and economic burdens globally because of their complex pathology and the limited availability of therapeutic approaches. Multiple microRNAs (miRNAs) play crucial roles in regulating biological processes in wound healing. However, single-miRNA therapies may not fully overcome the multifaceted barriers of impaired wound repair. Efforts to discover more effective wound therapies continue unabated.

pmc-13086956.title: Transfer learning and knowledge graph enhanced VR animation resource recommendation with creativity prediction
pmc-13086956.creator: Cong Yan, Hasnah Binti Mohamed
pmc-13086956.description: Virtual reality technology has transformed animation education by providing immersive learning environments, yet the proliferation of VR-based teaching resources presents significant challenges in resource discovery and personalized learning design. This research proposes an intelligent recommendation system that integrates transfer learning and knowledge graph technologies to address cold-start and data sparsity challenges in VR animation education.

pmc-13376943.title: Recyclable dual Z-scheme perovskite/g-C3N4 heterojunction enables photoredox nickel-catalyzed C(sp2)–C(sp3) cross-electrophile coupling
pmc-13376943.creator: Rui Wang, Donghao Huo, Shentong Xie, Honghui Ou, Renyi Shi
pmc-13376943.description: Nickel-catalyzed cross-electrophile coupling provides an efficient and cost-effective strategy for constructing C(sp2)–C(sp3) bonds, a pivotal transformation for diversifying molecular architectures in pharmaceutical and agrochemical synthesis. However, conventional methodologies usually require stoichiometric metal reductants, which pose safety risks, reaction instability, and environmental concerns. To circumvent these limitations, merging nickel catalysis with photoredox catalysis has emerged as a promising alternative.

pmc-13393241.title: Neurodegeneration as an evolutionary trade-off: a biological constraint–aware therapeutic perspective
pmc-13393241.creator: Seung Hyun Kim, Min-Young Noh, Matthew C Kiernan
pmc-13393241.description: lded limited and variable clinical benefits [1, 2], suggesting that broader biological contexts remain insufficiently addressed. Here, we propose a biological constraint–aware perspective in which neurodegeneration arises, in part, from the long-term consequences of evolutionary trade-offs and from biological constraints that may also operate independently within highly specialized neural systems.
